fetch logs
| filter process_label <> ""
| filterOut application_name == ""
| sort application_name asc
| summarize collectDistinct(application_name)

fetch logs //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| fieldsAdd strTenant=toString(environment_name)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(environment_name)

fetch logs 
| filter process_label <> ""//, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| fieldsAdd strStatus=toString(process_status)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(process_status)

fetch logs 
| filter process_label <> ""//, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| fieldsAdd strName=toString(process_name)
| sort strName asc
| summarize collectDistinct(process_name)

1.query:
fetch logs //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| filter outsystems.process.label <> ""
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.process.status, $Status)
| filter in(outsystems.process.name, $ProcessName)
|  fields
       Processname = outsystems.process.name,
        ProcessID = outsystems.process.id,
        application = outsystems.app.name,
		espace = outsystems.espace.name, 
		status = outsystems.process.status,
        environment = deployment.environment,
        created = outsystems.process.created,
        lastModified = outsystems.process.last_modified
| sort lastModified desc
 | summarize 
            Processname=collectDistinct(Processname),
            application=collectDistinct(application),
            espace=collectDistinct(espace),
            status=if(takeFirst(status) == "Closed", "🟢 CLOSED", else: "🔴 OPEN"),
            environment=collectDistinct(environment),
            created=takeLast(created),
            lastModified=takeLast(lastModified),
            by:ProcessID

| limit 10000

### Process dashboard
> the process dashboards shows the latest status of the processes.
